patthana22.16:1.1: na kusalaṃ na saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.16:2.1: na kusalaṃ na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na abyākataṃ na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na kusalaṃ na araṇañca na abyākataṃ na araṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. tīṇi. navedanāttika nahetuduke vedanāttika hetudukaṃ
